question: What did the best systems use for their model?
title: Applying a Pre-trained Language Model to Spanish Twitter Humor Prediction
answer_rationale: The best systems used an AWD_LSTM model with QRNN units for their language model, as stated in Text 6 [source_id=longrag_7], which details the LM training and fine-tuning process. This model was chosen for its improved training speed compared to alternatives like LSTM or Transformer Language models.
